# Robotics & A.I. Lab. (Jekyll + Bootstrap)

English-only lab website template using default Bootstrap styling.

## Local Preview

```bash
bundle install
bundle exec jekyll serve
```

## Publications (YAML)

Edit `/_data/publications.yml` to update the Publications page. This file is the single source of truth.

## Courses (YAML)

Edit `/_data/courses.yml` to update the Courses page. This file is the single source of truth.

## Research (YAML)

Edit `/_data/research.yml` to update the Research page. This file is the single source of truth.

## Pages

- Home: `index.md`
- People: `people.md`
- Research: `research.md`
- Publications: `publications.md`
- Courses: `courses.md`
- News: `news.md`
- Contact: `contact.md`

## Data

- People: `_data/people.yml`
- Research: `_data/research.yml`
- Publications: `_data/publications.yml`
- Courses: `_data/courses.yml`
- News: `_data/news.yml`
